summary: OpenAI describes how it built an agent runtime for the Responses API using a shell tool and hosted containers to run agents with files, tools, and state.

mechanisms.reason: The announcement describes infrastructure specifically built to run tool-using, stateful agents rather than single-turn model calls.
mechanisms.quote: How OpenAI built an agent runtime using the Responses API, shell tool, and hosted containers to run secure, scalable agents with files, tools, and state.
